_**Agent (gpt-5.4 2026-05-12 09:28:20Z)**_

`git push` was rejected because `origin/main` has commits your local `main` does not. Git blocks that to avoid overwriting remote history.

Use this if you want to keep both histories:

```bash
git fetch origin
git rebase origin/main
git push origin main
```

If rebase hits conflicts, resolve them, then run:

```bash
git rebase --continue
```

Only use this if you intentionally want to overwrite the remote branch with your local history:

```bash
git push --force-with-lease origin main
```
